messages.subject: Bioc-teaching meeting: Monday, August 17, 1pm CEST
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

Short reminder about next monday's meeting.

Here are the final points of last meeting's notes [1]:

How can we measure success?

How to certify new people to help us teach, and to grow the community?

How can we leverage the current momentum to start building something tangible? Start a GitHub repository?

How can we benefit from teaching material that we already have (developed for other courses)?

Is there Interest in a train the trainers course?
Best wishes,

Laurent

[1] https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s2QMk5XA-uhBVprAO3ZDk1Yfv1cnUWLp9zdvYq9Feu4/edit?usp=sharing
